title: Subtree of Another Tree
description:
Given the roots of two binary trees `root` and `subRoot`, return `true` if `subRoot` appears as a **subtree** of `root`.

A subtree is a node of `root` together with **all** of its descendants, so it must match `subRoot` exactly in both shape and values.

examples.explanation: The node 2 has an extra child 0 in root, so the subtrees differ.

hints: Try it at every node of root; the answer is true if any node's subtree matches subRoot.
